# Welcome to the home of International Association of Professional Farriers

![](https://mms.professionalfarriers.com/slideshows/images/AAPF/default/B0.664341001765296018.png)

## _Committed to Farrier Education_

[Who we are](https://professionalfarriers.com/#)

### [Who we are](https://professionalfarriers.com/\#)

The International Association of Professional Farriers Inc. is a not-for-profit corporation operated exclusively as a business trade organization within the meaning of Section 501(c)(6) of the Internal Revenue Code. The volunteer Board Members are elected by the membership, for the membership, in compliance with the constitution and bylaws of the association.

[What we do](https://professionalfarriers.com/#)

### [What we do](https://professionalfarriers.com/\#)

The International Association of Professional Farriers promotes the integrity of the farrier industry by strengthening the knowledge and skills of its members through continuing education and support at the state, national and international levels while improving overall equine health through collaboration with other industry professionals.  All payments (100%) to the IAPF may be deducted from federal income tax as a cost of doing business.

[Contact us](https://professionalfarriers.com/contact.php)

### [Contact us](https://professionalfarriers.com/contact.php)

**Mailing Address**

                       IAPF

                 PO Box 100

              Norvelt, PA 15674

**Phone**

Executive Director - (561) 909-7689

       Membership - (724) 953-9020

**Business Hours**

         9 AM to 5 PM, Weekdays

Update Your Information

We are happy to update your contact information, including email address, phone number and mailing address. Simply indicate "Update My Information" in the contact form, then enter your member ID and your new information. Your record will be updated promptly.  You may also update your information located in your profile once you have signed in.

Questions, Comments and Concerns

Please complete the contact form to submit your inquiry to IAPF. If you have multiple questions, please submit one form with all of your questions. You should receive an answer to your inquiry within 1-2 business days of receipt.  If you require immediate attention, please contact Member Services at 561-909-7689.

Thank you for your comments and for supporting the International Association of Professional Farriers. We look forward to hearing from you.

[Who we are](https://professionalfarriers.com/#)

### [Who we are](https://professionalfarriers.com/\#)

The International Association of Professional Farriers Inc. is a not-for-profit corporation operated exclusively as a business trade organization within the meaning of Section 501(c)(6) of the Internal Revenue Code. The volunteer Board Members are elected by the membership, for the membership, in compliance with the constitution and bylaws of the association.

[What we do](https://professionalfarriers.com/#)

### [What we do](https://professionalfarriers.com/\#)

The International Association of Professional Farriers promotes the integrity of the farrier industry by strengthening the knowledge and skills of its members through continuing education and support at the state, national and international levels while improving overall equine health through collaboration with other industry professionals.  All payments (100%) to the IAPF may be deducted from federal income tax as a cost of doing business.

**Business Hours**

         9 AM to 5 PM, Weekdays

Update Your Information

We are happy to update your contact information, including email address, phone number and mailing address. Simply indicate "Update My Information" in the contact form, then enter your member ID and your new information. Your record will be updated promptly.  You may also update your information located in your profile once you have signed in.

Questions, Comments and Concerns

Please complete the contact form to submit your inquiry to IAPF. If you have multiple questions, please submit one form with all of your questions. You should receive an answer to your inquiry within 1-2 business days of receipt.  If you require immediate attention, please contact Member Services at 561-909-7689.

Thank you for your comments and for supporting the International Association of Professional Farriers. We look forward to hearing from you.
